_comment: Per-hub exemptions for the exercise quality gate. Slug -> list of check IDs to skip.

_notes.R-Beginner-Exercises: Beginner-heavy by design; keeps Task/Expected fields but waives the difficulty-mix requirement.
_notes.R-Interview-Questions: Q&A style with conceptual questions; relax framing since not all interview questions have an expected result code block.
_notes.ggplot2-Recreation-Challenge: Featured plot-recreation collection curated at exactly 12 plots (owner spec, size 12). Waives the >=15 exercise-count floor for this collection only; all other checks apply.
_notes.Statistics-Interview-Questions: Featured interview-prep collection curated at exactly 25 problems (owner spec, size 25). Tier-1 catalog entry so waive the tier-1 >=45 exercise-count floor; all other checks apply.
_notes.Take-Home-Assignment-Simulator: Featured end-to-end simulation curated at exactly 15 graded steps (owner spec, size 15). Tier-1 catalog entry so waive the tier-1 >=45 exercise-count floor; all other checks apply.
